tools.name: scry_stats
tools.description:
Returns aggregate Scry corpus telemetry: total observation count, distinct
source IPs, first/last observation timestamps, last-24h activity, and
per-protocol breakdowns. Useful as a liveness/density check before issuing
per-IP queries — lets an agent decide whether the corpus has enough data
to be a

tools.name: scry_check
tools.description:
Returns Scry's corpus knowledge for a single IPv4 address: when it was first/last
observed, observation count, protocols and ports targeted, ASN, country, category
(actor/scanner/not_observed), and confidence_bucket (low/medium/high).

Use when an agent needs IP triage, hostility assessment, or risk

tools.name: scry_check_bulk
tools.description: Look up many IPv4 addresses in one request. Up to 100 IPs per call. Same per-IP shape as scry_check, keyed by IP.

tools.name: scry_top
tools.description: Top-N source dimensions over a time window. Useful for situational awareness — 'where is the noise coming from right now?'

tools.name: scry_timeseries
tools.description: Bucketed observation counts over time. Detect bursts, plot trends, sanity-check whether attacker activity is rising or falling.

tools.name: scry_asn
tools.description: Roll-up of corpus activity for a single ASN — observation count, distinct source IPs, actor count, scanner count, high-confidence actor count, and per-protocol breakdown.

tools.name: scry_country
tools.description: Roll-up of corpus activity by ISO country code. Same shape as scry_asn.

tools.name: scry_tools
tools.description: List detected attack tools — (protocol, payload, path) tuples sent by 3+ distinct source IPs. Aggregate metadata only; never lists member actors.

tools.name: scry_tool
tools.description: Single tool detail by 16-char hex id from scry_tools.

tools.name: scry_campaigns
tools.description: Active threat campaigns — coordinated attacker activity that exceeds the noise floor. ≥5 distinct actors, ≥3 ASNs, ≤5 destination ports, ≥1h history.

tools.name: scry_campaign
tools.description: Single campaign detail by id (format: c[0-9a-f]{15}).

tools.name: scry_recent
tools.description: Recent observations feed — aggregated by source IP within a time window. Cursor-paginated via since_ms.

findings.title: Anomalously long tool description
findings.detail: Description of "scry_stats" is 905 chars, far longer than this server's median (125). Overlong descriptions are a common place to bury instructions.
